 KEY TAKEAWAYS:
 CSK followed up their trade teaser with a goodnight post timed at 10:33 PM.
 Hardik Pandya wears the number 33 for India and the Mumbai Indians .
 CSK chief executive Kasi Viswanathan has previously denied any trade talks.
 CSK posts at 10:33 as fans continue decoding trade tweets
 This has been an eventful week for CSK fans. First it was Ashwin who fuelled the rumour mill with his cryptic tweet. Now, Chennai Super Kings ended Tuesday by feeding the Hardik Pandya saga and then signed off for the night in a way that only added to it.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Their last post of the day went up at 10:33 p.m., which is not a timestamp anybody in Chennai is going to read as a coincidence. "Good Night, Superfans. Note pannen too much decoding panreenga pa! [You're decoding this far too much]," the franchise wrote .
 It arrived hours after the franchise had released its support staff announcement, a video in which mascot Leo quizzes new head coach Zaheer Khan at the CSK headquarters.
 One of Leo's questions is about trade updates; Zaheer denies there are any, and the camera lingers long enough on the sheet of paper in front of him for the number on it to be read.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE:  Ashwin lights fire to Hardik-to-CSK trade rumour with cryptic post 
 Hardik Pandya's jersey number: What does 33 in CSK tweet mean?
 Hardik Pandya has worn 33 for India across formats and for the Mumbai Indians, having switched to it from 11 earlier in his career. That is the whole of the theory, and it is why a circled number on a prop in a coaching announcement set off an evening of speculation.
 The number itself is not as clear as the reaction suggests. Fans picking over the frame offered three readings, and the one they settled on was the one they wanted.
 "CSK videos cryptic trade message! What does the number in card looks like to you?!" one account posted , listing 53 for Avesh Khan, 55 for Washington Sundar and 33 for Hardik.
 Then came the goodnight post at 10:33, which removed most of the doubt about which number CSK wanted people looking at. A club that genuinely wanted the noise to die down had the option of posting at 10:30.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE:  Hardik Pandya's next IPL team: Three franchises are in talks with Mumbai Indians over possible trade - Report 
 What we know about the Hardik Pandya trade so far
 Very little of it is confirmed, and the one person at CSK who has addressed it directly said it was false. Viswanathan said earlier that no trade talks involving Pandya were taking place. Nine days ago, Ashwin, the most consistently informed voice on the subject, dismissed the idea.
 He called a move to CSK a long shot on his YouTube channel and said that, from what he had heard, the Rajasthan Royals were at the top of the list, having earlier warned people not to rule out a franchise outside CSK and KKR.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pandya's side of it is straightforward enough. He is 32, has not played competitive cricket since the Mumbai Indians finished ninth in IPL 2026, and is on ₹16.35 crore, which makes any deal a significant accounting item for whoever takes him.
